📄 Quotation Cover Letter
ℹ️ This cover letter prints as Page 1 of the Quotation (before the BOQ). Use [Client Name] as a placeholder — it's replaced automatically with the selected client's name when printing.
✅ Changes are saved automatically to your ERP and will appear in all future quotation prints.
📜 General Terms & Conditions
ℹ️ These terms print on the last page of every Quotation. Each line is one paragraph. Main clause headings should start with a number (e.g. 1. INTERPRETATION). Sub-clauses start with number.number (e.g. 1.1). Edit freely — changes apply to all future quotation prints.

💡 Mac: Auto-save PDFs to a fixed folder
To always save PDFs to the same folder without being asked each time:
Chrome: Settings → Downloads → turn off "Ask where to save each file" → set Download location to your folder (e.g. Documents/SBR Quotations)
Safari: Preferences → General → File download location → select your folder
📋 Key Terms & Conditions (shown on every quotation)
These 6 bullet points appear in the small "Key Terms & Conditions" box on every quotation PDF. One term per line. Keep them short.
🖨️ Letterhead — Used in All Printed Documents
ℹ️ Upload your company letterhead image. It will appear at the top of every printed document — Quotation, Invoice, Delivery Note, AMC Quotation and AMC Contract. Recommended size: A4 width (2480px), height as needed. PNG with transparent background works best.
